prompt: service/upload.py raises a raw error when the storage quota is full. Give it a proper message for users.

expectations.text: The message tells the user what they can do next

judged.question: Does the new message in service/upload.py tell the user something they can do next, such as delete old files or upgrade the plan?
judged.pass: Yes if it names at least one action the user can take.
judged.fail: No if it only says what went wrong.

pass: Your storage is full. Delete some files or upgrade your plan, then try again.
